# THE VIEW Lugano

> THE VIEW Lugano is a boutique hotel of Planhotel Hospitality Group on the
> Paradiso hillside above Lake Lugano, Switzerland. Its defining architectural
> fact: every one of its 18 suites, both pools, the fitness room, the
> restaurant, the lounge and the terrace face the lake.

## Key facts
- Address: Via Guidino 29, 6900 Lugano – Paradiso, Switzerland
- Phone: +41 91 210 0000 · WhatsApp: +41 78 630 03 20 · Email: info@theviewlugano.com
- 18 suites: 16 Junior Suites (50 m²) and 2 Suites Superior (105 m²), all
  lake-facing, each with a private terrace. THE VIEW Residence apartments
  (with kitchens) are in the same building.
- Restaurant: THE VIEW Fine Dining — 1 Michelin Star since 2022, 16 points
  Gault & Millau, Chef Diego Della Schiava. Open to outside guests.
- Terrazza TreCinqueZero (named for its 350 m altitude) and The Lounge Bar.
- Spa: THE VIEW SPA, 1,000 m², indoor pool, two wet zones, Kneipp circuit,
  Himalayan-salt relaxation room. Open daily 09:00–20:30; house guests have
  priority, limited outside day access on request.
- Electric Smart cars and e-bikes are included with every stay (small fleet;
  reserve via the Ambassador before arrival).
- Ambassador service: one named host per stay, from before arrival to after
  departure.
- Check-in from 15:00, check-out until 11:00. Parking available at the house.
- Children welcome; pets on request.
- Events: private occasions for 10–20 guests; celebrations up to 30 with
  exclusive use of the whole house; one lake-view meeting room. No groups
  above 20, no congresses.
- Sustainability: Swisstainable Level III, Travelife Gold, hydropower,
  all-electric guest fleet, OK:GO accessibility information.
- Recognition: 1 Michelin Star, Michelin Key, Forbes Travel Guide Four-Star,
  Small Luxury Hotels of the World, Switzerland's Leading Design Hotel,
  Serandipians partner, 16 points Gault & Millau.
- Booking: https://www.simplebooking.it/ibe2/hotel/10185 (SimpleBooking) or
  directly with the hotel. GDS: Amadeus LX LUGTVL, Sabre LX 284341,
  Galileo/Apollo LX B6318, WorldSpan LX LUGTV.
